text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Human rights group fears for life of Libyan journalist in Malta. "Liberty", a London-based human rights group claimed in a report issued in London on Sunday that a Libyan journalist in jail after entering the country illegally to seek political asylum had been visited by Libyan security agents and his family feared for his life.
- Foreign Minister George Vella reports British support for Malta's wish of closer ties with EU without membership. Vella had a meeting with British Foreign Secretary Malcom Rifkind on Wednesday.
- Report on Public Broadcasting Services issued. Problems caused by a lack of motivation despite good working conditions, the prime minister said.
- Prime minister urges civil service heads to better control spending.
